headerDisplay: For help and support please visit our GitHub Wiki. We hope you find this plugin useful!
footerDisplay: Everything is set up on this page. Turn on **Matter** for the bridge this plugin runs on (and **HomeKit**, for running tiles).

host.title: Shelly EM address (first start only; change it on the settings page)

channel.title: Which meter reading (first start only; change it on the settings page)
channel.description: auto (the first clamp, or all three phases of a 3EM), sum (all clamps added up), or one clamp such as em1:1 or emeter:1.

webPort.title: Web page port (0 = no web page)
webPort.description: The port of the plugin's own web page, for your home network only. It opens once a PIN is set on the settings page. 0 turns the web page off.
